features.title: Everything your shop needs

features.f1_desc: Search product name or scan barcode. Complete a sale in under 10 seconds.
features.f2_desc: Know exactly what you have at any moment. Get alerts before running out.
features.f3_desc: Record credit sales, track balances, and collect payments easily.
features.f4_desc: Daily revenue, top products, cashier performance. Know your numbers.

features.f6_desc: Install StockShop on Android or iPhone. Works offline — your data syncs automatically when you reconnect.

modules.title: Everything in one app

testimonials.title: What our customers say
testimonials.t1_text: Before StockShop, I never knew how much I was making daily. Now I check my phone and I know everything.
testimonials.t2_text: The credit tracking changed my management. Everything is recorded, no more disputes with customers.
testimonials.t3_text: StockShop transformed my shop. I know my stock and profits in real time, even when I'm away.
testimonials.t4_text: Expense tracking with receipts was exactly what I was missing. I can finally see the difference between my revenue and real profit.
testimonials.t5_text: I import products from West Africa. StockShop lets me manage everything from Paris in euros. The mobile app is perfect.
testimonials.t6_text: Managing multiple shops, I needed a reliable tool. StockShop gives me a complete view of all my stores from my phone.
testimonials.t7_text: Getting notifications when my cashiers make sales gives me peace of mind. I know what's happening even when I'm away.
testimonials.t8_text: I run my shop in Canada with StockShop. Multi-currency support and offline mode are exactly what's needed.
